learning_outcomes.text: (Reading) Students will be able to read and understand easy texts.
(Writing) They will be able to write letters with simple sentences, introduce themselves and others.
(Listening and Speaking) They will be able to listen to and understand basic daily conversations; introduce themselves and others with simple sentences and express themselves.
(Vocabulary) They will be able to recognize and use beginner-level vocabulary related to daily life.
Technology Use: They will acquire independent study skills by completing internet assignments given via technology, and can access all course materials through Moodle.

syllabus_topics: Subjects, Creating dialogues in class grammar
